_comment: Multi-provider config for the owned throughput benchmark. Every provider here exposes an OpenAI-COMPATIBLE /v1/chat/completions streaming endpoint, so one engine (the OpenAI Python SDK pointed at each base_url) serves them all. Per provider: base_url (null = OpenAI default), key_file (plain-text API key on the Desktop working folder), seed_families (substrings that identify the frontier chat models to track at discovery), exclude (substrings to skip), efforts (reasoning tiers to break out; [] = one default variant per model, pending calibration), and output filenames. OpenAI keeps its existing curated tracked_models.json + filenames untouched.

openai.note: Curated via tracked_models.json; efforts and exclude live there.
openai.budget_cap_note: Cumulative caps. openai 600->700 on 2026-07-30 (fourth revision): second fixed reference task ('reason-heavy', k=36) added at the 1k workload to measure task-demand sensitivity on clean bases. James monitors daily burn; credit limits raised.

anthropic.note: Anthropic OpenAI-compat endpoint. default_thinking=true: Claude 4.6+ thinks adaptively by default, so all variants get reasoning headroom (2026-07-23). Effort ladder via extra_body thinking budgets ('minimal' = thinking off = the R=1 baseline); VERIFY WITH `probe` before enabling efforts in the tracked file — the compat layer's acceptance of the thinking param is unconfirmed.
anthropic.budget_cap_note: Cap set to 130 on 2026-07-27 (was 175): current spend + ~30 days at observed burn. Single cap — matches the scheduled task's --budget. Revisit ~2026-08-27.

google.note: Gemini OpenAI-compat layer. default_thinking=true: 2.5/3.x think adaptively by default, so all variants get reasoning headroom (2026-07-23 — the missing headroom truncated gemini-3.5/3.6-flash answers). thoughtsTokenCount is harvested from usage where the compat layer exposes it, else derived from total-minus-parts. Effort breakout via reasoning_effort; VERIFY WITH `probe` before enabling efforts in the tracked file.
google.budget_cap_note: Cap set to 200 on 2026-07-27 (was 250): current spend + ~30 days at observed burn. Single cap — matches the scheduled task's --budget. Revisit ~2026-08-27.

mistral.note: Mistral OpenAI-compat endpoint. Magistral = reasoning family (thinking_families grants it headroom); reasoning streamed in-band as think tags is now split out of the visible series by the recorder (2026-07-23 — root cause of the magistral-small divergence). No effort dial.
mistral.budget_cap_note: Cap set to 130 on 2026-07-27 (was 175): current spend + ~30 days at observed burn. Single cap — matches the scheduled task's --budget. Revisit ~2026-08-27.

deepseek.note: DeepSeek OpenAI-compat endpoint. default_thinking=true: the campaign showed the 'minimal' variants STILL emit reasoning tokens (v4-pro minimal: ~687), so all variants get headroom and minimal is NOT a clean R=1 baseline. deepseek-chat added to the tracked file as the candidate true baseline; verify its reasoning_tokens are ~0 via `probe` before relying on it.
deepseek.budget_cap_note: Raised 90->110 on 2026-08-16: at $74 with six collection days to the 22 Aug close, the daily click (~$2.7/day incl. the new 10k and heavy-rung passes) would have hit the 90 cap around the 20th.
